sources.text: RareRAT Rone Coen Lp NPCI/UPI/OC No. 205/2024-25 27" August 2024 To, AIl UPI Members Dear Sir/Madam, Subject: Introduction of Auto Top-up on UPI LITE This is in reference to NPCI circular NPCI/UPI/OC No. 138/2021-22, dated 16" March 2022 and NPCI/UPI/OC No. 169/2023-24, dated 31° August 2023, whereby guidelines to operationalize UPI LITE small value transactions have been introduced. UPI LITE enhances the user experience by allowing PIN less transactions under 2500 with a maximum UPI LITE balance limit of 2000 at any point of time. To further augment the UPI LITE user experience, Auto Top-up on UPI LITE is being introduced. With this new feature, the UPI LITE balance will automatically be reloaded by an amount chosen by the user, not exceeding UPI LITE balance limit, whenever the balance falls below a minimum limit set by them. This increases the convenience and adaptability of UPI LITE by automating the process of reloading funds. Additionally, users shall be provided with the option of revoking the Auto Top-up mandate at any point of time by the PSP/App. Since the balance resides with user’s bank and the UPI LITE can be deleted anytime with instant refund of UPI LITE balance to user's main bank account, the requirement of pre-debit notification (PDN), which is a usual mechanism for merchant mandate payments, has been dispensed

sources.text: NPCI/UPI/OC No. 169/2023-24 31st August 2023 To All Member-Unified Payments Interface (UPI) Dear Madam/Sir, **Subject: Enhancement in UPI LITE transaction limit to ₹500** UPI LITE has been designed to play a vital role in reducing infrastructure load on the Core Banking System of the banks. This feature has been making the small value transactions faster and highly reliable for transaction value below ₹200. As per the latest circular issued by RBI on 24th August, 2023 vide Circular No: RBI/2023-24/57 CO.DPSS.POLC.No.S526/02-14-003/2023-24 with subject ‘Enhancing transaction limits for Small Value Digital Payments in Offline Mode’, the upper limit of an offline payment transaction is now increased from ₹200 to ₹500. In view of the above, the per transaction value limit for UPI LITE (Purpose code 44 - Online and 45 - Offline) has now been enhanced to ₹500. The details are as below: | UPI LITE Limit | Previous Limit | New Limit | |---|---|---| | Per Transaction | ₹200 | ₹500 | | Max balance in UPI lite account | ₹2000 | ₹2000 (No change) | The existing UPI pricing shall be applicable for transaction amount ₹201-₹500 for both P2P and P2M transactions. With reference to the above, Member Banks (Payee PSP), Third Party App providers (TPAPs), Merchants and other payment providers are requested to take note of the above enhancement

sources.text: RareRAT Rone Coen Lp NPCI/UPI/OC No. 205/2024-25 27" August 2024 To, AIl UPI Members Dear Sir/Madam, Subject: Introduction of Auto Top-up on UPI LITE This is in reference to NPCI circular NPCI/UPI/OC No. 138/2021-22, dated 16" March 2022 and NPCI/UPI/OC No. 169/2023-24, dated 31° August 2023, whereby guidelines to operationalize UPI LITE small value transactions have been introduced. UPI LITE enhances the user experience by allowing PIN less transactions under 2500 with a maximum UPI LITE balance limit of 2000 at any point of time. To further augment the UPI LITE user experience, Auto Top-up on UPI LITE is being introduced. With this new feature, the UPI LITE balance will automatically be reloaded by an amount chosen by the user, not exceeding UPI LITE balance limit, whenever the balance falls below a minimum limit set by them. This increases the convenience and adaptability of UPI LITE by automating the process of reloading funds. Additionally, users shall be provided with the option of revoking the Auto Top-up mandate at any point of time by the PSP/App. Since the balance resides with user’s bank and the UPI LITE can be deleted anytime with instant refund of UPI LITE balance to user's main bank account, the requirement of pre-debit notification (PDN), which is a usual mechanism for merchant mandate payments, has been dispensed

sources.text: NPCI/UPI/OC No. 169/2023-24 31st August 2023 To All Member-Unified Payments Interface (UPI) Dear Madam/Sir, **Subject: Enhancement in UPI LITE transaction limit to ₹500** UPI LITE has been designed to play a vital role in reducing infrastructure load on the Core Banking System of the banks. This feature has been making the small value transactions faster and highly reliable for transaction value below ₹200. As per the latest circular issued by RBI on 24th August, 2023 vide Circular No: RBI/2023-24/57 CO.DPSS.POLC.No.S526/02-14-003/2023-24 with subject ‘Enhancing transaction limits for Small Value Digital Payments in Offline Mode’, the upper limit of an offline payment transaction is now increased from ₹200 to ₹500. In view of the above, the per transaction value limit for UPI LITE (Purpose code 44 - Online and 45 - Offline) has now been enhanced to ₹500.
